title: Life Mace PVP
description: Simple tweaks to make mace pvp easier like making the mace smaller and some other simple tweaks.
body:
This is a recource pack that makes mace pvp easier with these features:

- Smaller mace
- Clear envintory
- Easier to see cobwebs
- Warning icon on slowfalling icon

  and much more


  Sorry that the images in the gallery are blurry if you want to see them properly just download the pack you can delete it if you dont like it.
